description: A Java class for an Android View that implements a simple joystick-based physics game, including game logic, object classes (Ship, Bullet, Obstacle), input handling, and rendering.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: Main custom View class for the game, handling game loop, input, drawing, and collision detection.

classes.name: Sprite
classes.description: Abstract base class for moving objects in the game, including position, velocity, size, and collision logic.

classes.name: Ship
classes.description: Represents the player's ship with drawing, movement, and collision detection.

classes.name: Bullet
classes.description: Represents bullets fired by the ship, with movement and rendering logic.

classes.name: Obstacle
classes.description: Represents obstacles in the game world, with movement and rendering features.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Resets the game when the view size changes.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key presses for DPad and fire button.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Starts or stops animation based on window focus.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Creates and fires a bullet from the ship.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that game objects like the ship are initialized.

methods.name: crash
methods.description: Triggers a crash feedback via vibration.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Advances the game state and schedules next frame.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advances game objects and handles collision detection.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders game objects onto the canvas.
